about: The wire rule as data. tools/versions.py, vertext.lua and vertext.mjs each implement it; version-gate.py, filter-golden.py and wasm-parity.mjs each assert their own implementation against every pair here, so the three cannot drift apart without one of them going red. `ours` is the half doing the checking (the filter or the glue), `theirs` the version the other half reports.

pairs.why: a patch release of the same minor
the same pair, the other way round
a pre-release refuses the release it is heading for
and the release refuses the pre-release
two different pre-releases of one minor
